384:t_012:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...A failure. He wasn't as useful as I'd thought.」

384:t_012:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「What did you do to $n, you bastard!?」

384:t_012:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He drew out his $$スフィア$$'s power through the opposing emotions of hope and despair...」

384:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So I fed them both. ...But he couldn't choose either, and his mind ended up dying.」

384:t_012:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「Positive and negative... He can't move toward either, and in the end, he becomes zero...」

384:t_012:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「So this is the backlash of the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$...!」

384:t_012:9.en:
$$桂$$
「You used Miss $$スズネ$$ to trigger it! That's a dirty trick!」

384:t_012:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「He hit this wall precisely because he had some talent.」

384:t_012:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$ was smarter. He never tried to challenge it in the first place.」

384:t_012:16.en:
$$甲児$$
「Shut up! You're the one who broke $n's mind!」

384:t_012:18.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Even a dog can bark. If you've got time for that, shouldn't you be thinking of a way to turn this situation around?」

384:t_012:19.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「This hopeless situation, that is.」

384:t_013:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Worry about your own lives before you worry about theirs.」

384:t_014:2.en:
$$葵$$
「And if we turn our backs on him now, he'll just pick us off!」

384:t_014:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「If we mistime our retreat, we could be wiped out. Above all, further combat will put the city's residents in danger.」

384:t_014:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you think I'll let you?」

384:t_015:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「We can't even get him to retreat like this!」

384:t_015:3.en:
$$甲児$$
「What are you going to try!?」

384:t_015:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「I'll dive into his mind and wake $n up!」

384:t_015:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「Can you do something like that!?」

384:t_015:6.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't know... But during the $$時獄戦役$$, I managed to enter the depths of $$グーラ$$'s mind.」

384:t_015:7.en:
$$タケル$$
「If I can recreate that feeling...!」

384:t_016:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's like when $$カグラ$$ and I connected our hearts...!」

384:t_016:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't know how much the $$クアンタ$$ and I can do as we are now, but...!」

384:t_016:5.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$クアンタム・バースト$$!!」

384:t_019:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It's time to finish you, $n. If I can't obtain it, I'll simply free the $$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$.」

384:t_020:1.en:
$n
「...$$バルビエル$$. You said you'd kill Miss $$スズネ$$.」

384:t_020:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Don't think it was an empty threat.」

384:t_020:5.en:
$n
「You know what'll happen then, don't you!?」

384:t_020:7.en:
$n
「You can't, can you? Miss $$スズネ$$ is your trump card against me. You can't play her that easily.」

384:t_020:8.en:
$n
「Besides, you never intended to use Miss $$スズネ$$ as a hostage! If you did, you'd have brought her here!」

384:t_020:10.en:
$n
「Listen, $$バルビエル$$! If you've already killed Miss $$スズネ$$, I'll never forgive you!」

384:t_020:11.en:
$n
「No... I won't forgive you for trying to use Miss $$スズネ$$ in this fight!」

384:t_020:12.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Are you in any position to talk so big!?」

384:t_020:16.en:
$$シン$$
「Show him the results of your training!!」

384:t_022:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「He blew right through the backlash!?」
